newsitem.title: FRANCE: French garden gnome-snatchers strike again.
newsitem.headline: French garden gnome-snatchers strike again.

text.p: Garden gnomes are again disappearing in France now that a spoof group idolising Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs has resumed its campaign to "liberate" the statues from flower beds and well-kept lawns.

The Garden Gnomes Liberation Front, which operates seven-member night-time "commandos" to snatch the gnomes, has made off with a dozen ceramic dwarfs this week around Dunkirk, near the Belgian border, residents say.
The masked raiders declared a "truce" in January after rounding up about 30 gnomes in Normandy and "freeing" them in local forests, presumably to return to the normal life of a story-book dwarf.

In each of the latest abductions, the Front left a message saying: "Dear Papa, Dear Mama -- I was happy with you but now I have to leave you. Signed: your garden gnome." One message said the group wanted to "reeducate" the dwarfs.
